signs.zh: 碰外耳 / 拉耳朵会痛
异常或不易止住的出血

signs.en: Pain migrated to right lower abdomen

name.zh: 肌肉拉伤或负荷不适

advice.zh: 先减少引发疼痛的动作，短时间冷敷，之后按舒适程度热敷和轻柔活动。
advice.en: Reduce the triggering activity.

shortDescription.zh: 运动、反复用力或外伤后肌肉痛，活动可诱发。
shortDescription.en: Muscle pain after exercise, repetitive use or injury, often provoked by movement.

triggers.zh: 重复负荷、突然发力或长时间保持同一姿势
triggers.en: Repeated load, sudden exertion or a prolonged posture

threshold.zh: 无法承重、明显肿胀或症状持续不改善：就医。
threshold.en: Seek care for inability to bear weight, marked swelling or failure to improve.

name.zh: 神经受刺激或受压

advice.zh: 避免长时间压迫患处，记录麻木范围和变化。
advice.en: Avoid prolonged pressure and note how numbness changes.

shortDescription.zh: 麻木、针刺或电击样痛，可沿肢体放射。
shortDescription.en: Numbness, tingling or electric pain that may radiate along a limb.

triggers.zh: 局部压迫、姿势受限或邻近组织肿胀
triggers.en: Local pressure, restricted posture or nearby swelling

threshold.zh: 新发无力、面部歪斜、说话含糊或大小便异常：立即急诊。
threshold.en: New weakness, facial droop, slurred speech or bladder/bowel changes: emergency assessment.

name.zh: 皮肤刺激或炎症

advice.zh: 保持清洁干燥，避免抓挠和新用的护肤品。
advice.en: Keep the area clean and dry.

shortDescription.zh: 皮肤灼痛、刺痛，伴红斑、干燥或脱皮。
shortDescription.en: Burning or stinging skin with redness, dryness or peeling.

triggers.zh: 摩擦、汗液、清洁剂或新接触的产品
triggers.en: Friction, sweat, cleansers or a newly introduced product

threshold.zh: 红肿快速扩散、发热或流脓：尽快就医。
threshold.en: Rapidly spreading redness, fever or pus: seek prompt care.

name.zh: 关节或周围组织炎症

advice.zh: 减少负重，短时间冷敷并观察活动范围。
advice.en: Reduce load and use a short cold pack while watching range of motion.

shortDescription.zh: 关节周围胀痛、红热，活动受限。
shortDescription.en: Pain and warmth around a joint with restricted movement.

triggers.zh: 重复负重、扭转、外伤或关节周围刺激
triggers.en: Repeated loading, twisting, injury or irritation around a joint

threshold.zh: 明显变形、无法活动或红热关节伴发热：尽快就医。
threshold.en: Deformity, inability to move or a hot joint with fever: seek prompt care.

name.zh: 接触性皮炎或荨麻疹样反应（需鉴别）

advice.zh: 避免抓挠和近期新用的产品，温和清洁并保持干燥。
advice.en: Avoid scratching and recently introduced products.

shortDescription.zh: 瘙痒伴红斑、脱皮、水疱或短暂风团。
shortDescription.en: Itch with redness, scaling, blisters or transient wheals.

triggers.zh: 新护肤品、洗涤剂、金属或环境暴露
triggers.en: A new skincare product, detergent, metal or environmental exposure

threshold.zh: 面唇舌肿胀、喘鸣或吞咽困难提示严重过敏；皮疹迅速扩散、流脓、明显疼痛或伴发热时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Swelling of the lips, tongue or face, wheeze or trouble swallowing can signal a severe allergy. Seek prompt care if the rash spreads quickly, drains, becomes very painful or comes with fever.

name.zh: 软组织挫伤（可能）

advice.zh: 先停止会加重不适的活动，短时间冷敷并抬高患处（如舒适）。
advice.en: Stop activities that worsen symptoms.

shortDescription.zh: 碰撞后局部淤青、压痛和肿胀。
shortDescription.en: Local bruising, tenderness and swelling after an impact.

triggers.zh: 碰撞、挤压或轻微扭伤
triggers.en: A bump, compression or minor twist

threshold.zh: 肿胀快速增大、无法活动或承重、肢体麻冷、疼痛持续加重，或无明显外伤却反复淤青时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for rapidly increasing swelling, inability to move or bear weight, a cold or numb limb, worsening pain, or recurrent bruising without a clear injury.

name.zh: 肌肉痉挛（可能）

advice.zh: 先停下活动，按舒适程度轻柔拉伸和放松，日常补充水分。
advice.en: Pause the activity and gently stretch or relax the area as comfortable.

shortDescription.zh: 肌肉突然紧缩、变硬，出现短暂疼痛。
shortDescription.en: Sudden painful tightening and hardening of a muscle.

triggers.zh: 运动、出汗、脱水或长时间保持姿势
triggers.en: Exercise, sweating, dehydration or holding one posture

threshold.zh: 痉挛持续不缓解、反复频繁、伴明显无力、肿胀、发热或尿色明显变深时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek care if a cramp does not release, keeps recurring, or comes with marked weakness, swelling, fever or very dark urine.

name.zh: 紧张型头痛（可能）

advice.zh: 在安静、光线较低的地方休息，补充日常水分并记录诱因。
advice.en: Rest in a quiet, dim place, keep up ordinary hydration, and note possible triggers.

shortDescription.zh: 双侧或环形紧箍样头痛，可伴颈肩紧张。
shortDescription.en: Bilateral or band-like headache, sometimes with neck tension.

triggers.zh: 压力、睡眠不足、久坐或颈肩紧张
triggers.en: Stress, poor sleep, prolonged sitting or neck and shoulder tension

threshold.zh: 突然达到最严重、伴高热颈硬、意识改变、单侧无力、视力异常或反复呕吐时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for sudden worst-ever pain, fever with stiff neck, confusion, one-sided weakness, vision change or repeated vomiting.

name.zh: 牙髓炎线索

advice.zh: 先避开冷热甜刺激，保持清洁并预约牙科检查。
advice.en: Avoid hot, cold and sweet triggers, keep the area clean, and arrange a dental exam.

shortDescription.zh: 冷热刺激后持续痛或自发夜间痛，也可牵涉到邻牙和颌面。
shortDescription.en: Lingering thermal or spontaneous/night pain may refer to adjacent teeth or the jaw.

triggers.zh: 龋洞加深、冷热刺激或牙体裂纹
triggers.en: Deep decay, hot or cold triggers, or a tooth crack

threshold.zh: 面部或颈部肿胀、发热、吞咽或呼吸困难时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Go to urgent care now for facial or neck swelling, fever, or difficulty swallowing or breathing.

name.zh: 鼻窦炎样症状

advice.zh: 补充水分，避免烟雾等刺激，按说明使用盐水清洁。
advice.en: Hydrate, avoid smoke and other irritants, and use saline rinses as directed.

shortDescription.zh: 鼻塞伴脓性鼻涕或面部压胀；不能据此区分病毒与细菌感染。
shortDescription.en: Nasal blockage with purulent discharge or facial pressure does not distinguish viral from bacterial infection.

triggers.zh: 上呼吸道感染、过敏或鼻腔引流受阻
triggers.en: An upper-airway infection, allergy or blocked nasal drainage

threshold.zh: 眼周肿胀或视力改变、剧烈头痛、颈项僵硬或高热时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for swelling around the eye, vision changes, severe headache, stiff neck or high fever.

name.zh: 鼻部外伤或鼻出血（可能）

advice.zh: 坐直并身体前倾，捏住鼻翼软部持续十分钟。
advice.en: Sit upright and lean forward while pinching the soft part of the nose for ten minutes.

shortDescription.zh: 鼻部疼痛、肿胀或出血，可与碰撞有关。
shortDescription.en: Nasal pain, swelling or bleeding, sometimes after an impact.

triggers.zh: 鼻部碰撞、抠鼻、干燥空气或用力擤鼻
triggers.en: Nasal impact, picking, dry air or forceful nose blowing

threshold.zh: 出血持续超过二十分钟、鼻形明显改变、头部受伤后嗜睡或清液流出时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care if bleeding lasts over twenty minutes, the nose is visibly deformed, or head injury causes drowsiness or clear fluid drainage.

name.zh: 脊柱机械性疼痛（可能）

advice.zh: 暂时减少诱发动作，保持轻柔活动，避免长时间卧床。
advice.en: Temporarily reduce triggering movements, keep gentle activity, and avoid prolonged bed rest.

shortDescription.zh: 颈背痛随姿势、弯腰或转身变化。
shortDescription.en: Neck or back pain that changes with posture, bending or turning.

triggers.zh: 久坐、搬抬、姿势变化或突然扭转
triggers.en: Prolonged sitting, lifting, posture change or sudden twisting

threshold.zh: 新出现的肢体无力、会阴麻木、大小便控制改变、发热或重大外伤后疼痛需立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for new weakness, saddle numbness, bowel or bladder changes, fever, or pain after major trauma.

name.zh: 神经根刺激或受压（可能）

advice.zh: 避免持续压迫和反复搬重物，记录放射范围与力量变化。
advice.en: Avoid prolonged pressure and repeated heavy lifting, and note the spread and any strength changes.

shortDescription.zh: 颈背痛向肢体放射，可伴麻刺或无力。
shortDescription.en: Pain radiating from the neck or back into a limb, with possible tingling or weakness.

triggers.zh: 椎间盘负荷、咳嗽用力或长时间弯腰
triggers.en: Disc loading, forceful coughing or prolonged bending

threshold.zh: 进行性无力、走路不稳、双侧症状、会阴麻木或大小便异常时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Get emergency help for progressive weakness, unsteady walking, symptoms on both sides, saddle numbness, or bowel or bladder changes.

name.zh: 肋骨或胸壁损伤（可能）

advice.zh: 减少扭转和提重物，按舒适程度冷敷并保持正常浅深呼吸。
advice.en: Reduce twisting and heavy lifting, use a cold pack if comfortable, and keep breathing normally.

shortDescription.zh: 局部胸壁压痛，深呼吸、咳嗽或转身时加重。
shortDescription.en: Focal chest-wall tenderness, worse with breathing, coughing or turning.

triggers.zh: 碰撞、剧烈咳嗽或深呼吸牵拉
triggers.en: Impact, forceful coughing or strain with deep breathing

threshold.zh: 呼吸困难、咳血、嘴唇发青、胸痛压榨感或受伤后头晕需立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for breathing difficulty, coughing blood, blue lips, crushing chest pain, or dizziness after injury.

name.zh: 肩袖肌腱或滑囊刺激（可能）

advice.zh: 短期减少过顶动作，保持无痛范围内活动，避免强行拉伸。
advice.en: Temporarily reduce overhead activity, move within a comfortable range, and avoid forceful stretching.

shortDescription.zh: 抬臂或患侧卧时肩痛，可伴活动受限。
shortDescription.en: Shoulder pain with arm elevation or lying on the affected side.

triggers.zh: 反复过顶动作、抬臂或侧卧压迫
triggers.en: Repeated overhead activity, lifting the arm or lying on that side

threshold.zh: 明显变形、突然无法抬臂、手臂发凉发白或伴胸痛气促时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for visible deformity, sudden inability to lift the arm, a cold or pale arm, or chest pain with breathlessness.

name.zh: 尺神经分布异常线索（位置待评估）

advice.zh: 减少长时间压迫和重复姿势，记录麻木分布；持续或力量下降时安排检查，先确认受影响部位。
advice.en: Reduce prolonged pressure and repetitive postures and record the numbness distribution. Persistent symptoms or reduced strength need examination to establish the affected site.

shortDescription.zh: 无名指、小指麻木伴所选时间或力量变化，可涉及尺神经通路；不能仅据这些选择确认肘部受压。
shortDescription.en: Ring- and little-finger numbness with the selected timing or strength changes may involve the ulnar pathway; these selections do not establish compression at the elbow.

triggers.zh: 可能与肘或腕部等位置受压、反复姿势有关，具体部位待检查。
triggers.en: Pressure around the elbow or wrist and repetitive postures may be relevant; the specific site needs examination.

threshold.zh: 握力进行性下降、手指明显无力、手部肌肉变薄或持续麻木时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for worsening grip loss, marked finger weakness, visible hand-muscle wasting, or persistent numbness.

name.zh: 踝部扭伤（可能）

advice.zh: 保护患处并短时间冷敷、抬高。
advice.en: Protect the ankle with a short cold pack and elevation.

shortDescription.zh: 扭转后踝部疼痛、肿胀或淤青。
shortDescription.en: Ankle pain, swelling or bruising after twisting.

triggers.zh: 踩空、内翻或运动中的突然变向
triggers.en: A misstep, inversion or sudden change of direction

threshold.zh: 明显畸形、脚趾发凉发白、麻木或疼痛迅速加重时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for deformity, cold or pale toes, numbness, or rapidly worsening pain.

name.zh: 足底筋膜或足部负荷疼痛（可能）

advice.zh: 减少高冲击活动，穿有支撑的鞋，做温和小腿和足底活动。
advice.en: Reduce high-impact activity, use supportive footwear, and try gentle calf and foot mobility.

shortDescription.zh: 晨起第一步或久站后足跟、足底疼痛。
shortDescription.en: Heel or sole pain on the first steps or after prolonged standing.

triggers.zh: 久站、跑跳、鞋底支撑不足或活动量增加
triggers.en: Long standing, running, poor shoe support or increased activity

threshold.zh: 足部明显发红发热、伤口流脓、无法承重或糖尿病伴新足部伤口时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for marked redness and warmth, drainage, inability to bear weight, or a new foot wound with diabetes.

name.zh: 脑神经感觉或运动变化（可能）
name.en: Possible cranial-nerve sensory or motor change

advice.zh: 记录症状开始时间、侧别和变化，避免驾驶等有风险活动，并尽快安排评估。
advice.en: Record onset, side and changes, avoid risky activities such as driving, and arrange prompt assessment.

shortDescription.zh: 面部感觉、表情、眼球运动、听觉或吞咽改变。
shortDescription.en: Changes in facial sensation, expression, eye movement, hearing or swallowing.

triggers.zh: 感染、外伤或突然出现的神经功能变化
triggers.en: Infection, injury or a sudden neurological change

threshold.zh: 面部歪斜、说话含糊、吞咽困难、突发视力丧失或肢体无力需立即急诊。
threshold.en: Get emergency help for facial droop, slurred speech, trouble swallowing, sudden vision loss or limb weakness.

name.zh: 脊髓相关警示模式（需评估）

advice.zh: 记录实际感觉、步行和力量变化，避免高风险运动，尽快就医评估。
advice.en: Record actual sensory, walking and strength changes, avoid risky activity and seek prompt assessment.

shortDescription.zh: 会阴感觉或排尿功能变化伴所选神经线索，需要优先评估；点击结构不能定位病变。
shortDescription.en: Saddle-sensation or urinary changes with the selected neurological findings need priority assessment; clicking a structure cannot locate a lesion.

triggers.zh: 外伤、脊柱压迫或进行性神经症状
triggers.en: Trauma, spinal compression or progressive neurological symptoms

threshold.zh: 进行性无力、走路不稳、会阴麻木或大小便控制改变时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for progressive weakness, unsteady walking, saddle numbness, or bowel or bladder changes.

name.zh: 腹壁肌肉拉伤或过度使用（可能）

advice.zh: 先减少诱发动作，保持轻柔活动并观察咳嗽、起身时变化。
advice.en: Reduce triggering movement, keep gentle activity, and observe changes with coughing or rising.

shortDescription.zh: 咳嗽、起身或扭转时局部腹壁牵拉痛。
shortDescription.en: Focal pulling pain in the abdominal wall with coughing, sitting up or twisting.

triggers.zh: 咳嗽、扭转、仰卧起坐或搬重物
triggers.en: Coughing, twisting, sit-ups or lifting

threshold.zh: 持续加重的腹痛、明显包块、呕吐、发热或腹部僵硬时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for worsening abdominal pain, a marked bulge, vomiting, fever or a rigid abdomen.

name.zh: 颈部肌肉紧张或拉伤（可能）

advice.zh: 调整屏幕和睡眠姿势，短时间热敷并做舒适范围内活动。
advice.en: Adjust screen and sleep posture, use brief warmth and move within comfort.

shortDescription.zh: 颈部酸痛、紧绷，转头时加重。
shortDescription.en: Neck aching or tightness, worse when turning the head.

triggers.zh: 久坐、低头、睡姿改变或突然转头
triggers.en: Prolonged sitting, looking down, a changed sleep posture or sudden turning

threshold.zh: 颈痛伴发热和颈项僵硬、手臂无力麻木、吞咽困难或重大外伤时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for neck pain with fever and stiffness, arm weakness or numbness, trouble swallowing, or major trauma.

name.zh: 胸腰背肌筋膜疼痛（可能）

advice.zh: 减少重复弯转和久坐，保持轻柔行走与活动。
advice.en: Reduce repetitive bending and prolonged sitting while keeping gentle walking and movement.

shortDescription.zh: 胸腰背部紧绷、压痛，随活动变化。
shortDescription.en: Thoracic or lumbar tightness and tenderness that vary with movement.

triggers.zh: 久坐、反复弯腰、搬抬或核心负荷增加
triggers.en: Prolonged sitting, repeated bending, lifting or increased core load

threshold.zh: 进行性无力、会阴麻木、大小便变化、发热或不明原因体重下降时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for progressive weakness, saddle numbness, bowel or bladder changes, fever or unexplained weight loss.

name.zh: 龋病线索

advice.zh: 避开冷热甜刺激并预约牙科检查，保持清洁。
advice.en: Avoid cold, hot and sweet triggers, arrange a dental examination and keep the area clean.

shortDescription.zh: 可见牙体龋洞，伴冷热敏感或咬合痛。
shortDescription.en: A visible cavity with thermal sensitivity or biting pain.

triggers.zh: 高频摄入含糖食物、菌斑堆积或牙面磨损
triggers.en: Frequent sugar exposure, plaque build-up or enamel wear

threshold.zh: 面部肿胀、发热、吞咽或呼吸困难时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for facial swelling, fever, difficulty swallowing or breathing.

name.zh: 牙龈炎线索

advice.zh: 使用软毛牙刷轻柔清洁，避免吸烟和反复刺激，尽快预约牙科。
advice.en: Clean gently with a soft toothbrush, avoid smoking and repeated irritation, and arrange a dental appointment soon.

shortDescription.zh: 牙龈出血伴肿胀或异味；松动及退缩另需牙周评估。
shortDescription.en: Bleeding gums with swelling or bad breath; looseness/recession needs periodontal review.

triggers.zh: 牙菌斑、牙石、吸烟或口腔清洁不足
triggers.en: Plaque, calculus, smoking or inadequate oral hygiene

threshold.zh: 面部肿胀、发热、流脓或张口困难时及时就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for facial swelling, fever, pus or difficulty opening the mouth.

name.zh: 颞下颌关节或咀嚼肌功能障碍（可能）

advice.zh: 暂时吃软食，避免大张口和咬硬物，热敷并记录卡顿情况。
advice.en: Temporarily choose soft foods, avoid wide opening and hard biting, use a warm compress and note any catching.

shortDescription.zh: 耳前或咀嚼肌痛，张口弹响、受限或卡住。
shortDescription.en: Pain near the ear or chewing muscles with clicking, restricted opening or locking.

triggers.zh: 磨牙、咬紧、偏侧咀嚼或张口过度
triggers.en: Bruxism, clenching, one-sided chewing or excessive opening

threshold.zh: 关节锁住、明显外伤、面部肿胀或吞咽呼吸困难时及时就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for a locked jaw, significant injury, facial swelling or difficulty swallowing or breathing.

name.zh: 牙体裂纹或牙折（可能）

advice.zh: 避免用患侧咀嚼，保留脱落碎片，尽快看牙科。
advice.en: Avoid chewing on the affected side, keep any broken fragments and see a dentist promptly.

shortDescription.zh: 咬合锐痛、冷热敏感，可出现在外伤后。
shortDescription.en: Sharp biting pain or temperature sensitivity, sometimes after injury.

triggers.zh: 咬硬物、磨牙或直接外伤
triggers.en: Biting something hard, bruxism or direct trauma

threshold.zh: 牙齿明显移位、持续出血、面部肿胀或吞咽困难时急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for a clearly displaced tooth, persistent bleeding, facial swelling or difficulty swallowing.

name.zh: 偏头痛样发作（可能）

advice.zh: 安静避光休息，记录持续时间和诱因。
advice.en: Rest in a quiet, dark place and record duration and triggers.

shortDescription.zh: 搏动性头痛，伴恶心、畏光或视觉先兆。
shortDescription.en: Throbbing headache with nausea, light sensitivity or visual aura.

triggers.zh: 睡眠不足、压力、漏餐、酒精或强光
triggers.en: Poor sleep, stress, missed meals, alcohol or bright light

threshold.zh: 突然最严重头痛、发热颈硬、意识改变或单侧无力时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for a sudden worst-ever headache, fever with a stiff neck, altered awareness or one-sided weakness.

name.zh: 三叉神经痛样发作（可能）

advice.zh: 记录触发动作和疼痛分布，避免自行加大止痛药剂量，尽快安排评估。
advice.en: Record triggering actions and the pain distribution. Do not increase painkiller doses yourself; arrange assessment promptly.

shortDescription.zh: 单侧面部短促电击样痛，轻触或咀嚼可诱发。
shortDescription.en: Brief electric-shock facial pain, triggered by light touch or chewing.

triggers.zh: 触碰面部、咀嚼、刷牙或冷风
triggers.en: Facial touch, chewing, brushing teeth or cold air

threshold.zh: 伴面部无力、持续感觉缺失、视力改变或其他神经症状时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek immediate care for facial weakness, persistent sensory loss, vision changes or other neurological symptoms.

name.zh: 腕管综合征样正中神经受压（可能）

advice.zh: 减少长时间屈腕和重复抓握，保持腕部中立。
advice.en: Reduce prolonged wrist bending and repetitive gripping; keep the wrist in a neutral position.

shortDescription.zh: 拇、食、中指麻刺，常在夜间加重。
shortDescription.en: Tingling in the thumb, index and middle fingers, often worse at night.

triggers.zh: 腕部反复屈曲、握持工具或夜间压迫
triggers.en: Repeated wrist flexion, tool use or pressure during sleep

threshold.zh: 手部进行性无力、肌肉萎缩或麻木持续扩展时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for progressive hand weakness, muscle wasting or persistently spreading numbness.

name.zh: 坐骨神经放射痛样表现（可能）

advice.zh: 保持轻柔活动，避免长时间坐压和突然搬重物，记录力量与步态变化。
advice.en: Keep gently active, avoid prolonged sitting pressure and sudden heavy lifting, and note changes in strength and walking.

shortDescription.zh: 沿腿向下的放射痛，伴所选感觉或力量变化；需检查区分神经根及周围神经等来源。
shortDescription.en: Pain radiating down the leg with the selected sensory or strength changes needs examination to distinguish nerve-root and peripheral nerve sources.

triggers.zh: 久坐、弯腰、搬抬或腰骶部负荷
triggers.en: Prolonged sitting, bending, lifting or lumbosacral load

threshold.zh: 脚下垂、进行性无力、会阴麻木或大小便异常时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for foot drop, progressive weakness, saddle numbness or bladder or bowel changes.

name.zh: 周围神经病变样感觉（可能）

advice.zh: 记录对称范围和进展，检查鞋袜及皮肤是否受伤，尽快安排评估。
advice.en: Record the symmetrical distribution and progression, check footwear and skin for injury, and arrange assessment promptly.

shortDescription.zh: 双侧对称麻木、灼烧或针刺，常累及手足。
shortDescription.en: Symmetric numbness, burning or tingling, often in hands or feet.

triggers.zh: 代谢异常、营养不足、药物或长期压迫
triggers.en: Metabolic problems, nutritional deficiency, medication or chronic pressure

threshold.zh: 快速进展的无力、呼吸吞咽困难或步行明显不稳时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek immediate care for rapidly progressing weakness, difficulty breathing or swallowing, or marked unsteadiness when walking.

name.zh: 面神经功能异常样表现（需评估）

advice.zh: 记录开始时间并保护眼睛避免干燥，尽快就医评估。
advice.en: Record the onset time, protect the eye from drying and seek prompt medical assessment.

shortDescription.zh: 单侧表情无力、口角下垂或闭眼不全。
shortDescription.en: One-sided facial weakness, drooping mouth or incomplete eye closure.

triggers.zh: 感染后或突然出现的单侧面部功能改变
triggers.en: A post-infectious or sudden one-sided facial change

threshold.zh: 突然面部歪斜伴说话含糊、手臂无力或视力异常时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for sudden facial droop with slurred speech, arm weakness or vision changes.

name.zh: 肌腱过度使用或腱病（可能）

advice.zh: 减少诱发负荷但保持舒适范围活动，逐步恢复。
advice.en: Reduce provoking loads while keeping movement within a comfortable range; return to activity gradually.

shortDescription.zh: 肌腱附近压痛，用力或重复动作时疼痛。
shortDescription.en: Tenderness near a tendon with pain on loading or repetitive motion.

triggers.zh: 重复动作、训练量突然增加或恢复不足
triggers.en: Repetitive motion, a sudden training increase or inadequate recovery

threshold.zh: 突然断裂感、明显无力、快速肿胀或无法承重时及时就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for a sudden snapping sensation, marked weakness, rapid swelling or inability to bear weight.

name.zh: 滑囊炎样局部疼痛（可能）

advice.zh: 减少直接压迫，短时间冷敷并保持轻柔活动。
advice.en: Reduce direct pressure, use brief cold compresses and keep gently active.

shortDescription.zh: 关节旁压痛、局部肿胀，受压时加重。
shortDescription.en: Tenderness and swelling beside a joint, worse with direct pressure.

triggers.zh: 局部反复受压、跪坐或重复摩擦
triggers.en: Repeated local pressure, kneeling or friction

threshold.zh: 高热、迅速扩大的红肿、流脓或无法活动时尽快就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for high fever, rapidly spreading redness and swelling, pus or inability to move.

name.zh: 膝半月板或韧带损伤样表现（可能）

advice.zh: 停止扭转和跑跳，抬高并短时间冷敷，尽快评估。
advice.en: Stop twisting, running and jumping. Elevate the area, use brief cold compresses and arrange prompt assessment.

shortDescription.zh: 扭伤后膝肿、卡顿、锁住或不稳。
shortDescription.en: Knee swelling, catching, locking or instability after twisting.

triggers.zh: 膝部扭转、变向、跌倒或运动外伤
triggers.en: Knee twisting, pivoting, falling or sports injury

threshold.zh: 无法承重、明显变形、膝关节锁死或肿胀迅速出现时及时就医。
threshold.en: Seek prompt care for inability to bear weight, obvious deformity, a locked knee or rapid swelling.

name.zh: 胃肠炎样腹痛（可能）

advice.zh: 少量多次补充水分和电解质，暂时选择清淡饮食。
advice.en: Replace fluids and electrolytes in small, frequent amounts and temporarily choose bland foods.

shortDescription.zh: 腹部绞痛伴腹泻、恶心或呕吐。
shortDescription.en: Abdominal cramping with diarrhoea, nausea or vomiting.

triggers.zh: 受污染食物、接触感染者或饮食刺激
triggers.en: Contaminated food, contact with infection or dietary irritation

threshold.zh: 无法进水、明显脱水、血便、持续高热或剧烈腹痛时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek immediate care for inability to take fluids, marked dehydration, blood in stool, persistent high fever or severe abdominal pain.

name.zh: 阑尾炎警示模式（需排查）

advice.zh: 避免自行热敷、泻药或大量进食，尽快就医检查。
advice.en: Avoid applying heat, taking laxatives or eating large amounts; seek prompt medical assessment.

shortDescription.zh: 腹痛逐渐集中到右下腹，可伴恶心、发热。
shortDescription.en: Abdominal pain concentrating in the lower right side, with possible nausea or fever.

triggers.zh: 阑尾腔阻塞或腹腔炎症过程
triggers.en: Appendiceal blockage or an inflammatory abdominal process

threshold.zh: 疼痛持续加重、走动震动明显加重、腹部僵硬或反复呕吐时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for steadily worsening pain, pain markedly worsened by movement, abdominal rigidity or repeated vomiting.

name.zh: 泌尿系或肾绞痛样表现（需鉴别）
name.en: Possible urinary or renal colic pattern

advice.zh: 记录尿色、排尿和疼痛波动，补充适量水分并尽快评估。
advice.en: Record urine colour, urination and changes in pain, maintain appropriate hydration and arrange prompt assessment.

shortDescription.zh: 腰侧绞痛向腹股沟放射，可伴血尿或恶心。
shortDescription.en: Colicky flank pain radiating to the groin, sometimes with blood in urine or nausea.

triggers.zh: 尿路结石移动、脱水或泌尿系感染
triggers.en: A moving urinary stone, dehydration or urinary infection

threshold.zh: 发热寒战、无法排尿、血尿明显、持续呕吐或疼痛无法控制时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek immediate care for fever or chills, inability to urinate, marked blood in urine, persistent vomiting or uncontrolled pain.

name.zh: 呼吸相关胸壁或胸膜疼痛（需鉴别）
name.en: Possible pleuritic chest or chest-wall pain

advice.zh: 暂停剧烈活动并记录呼吸变化，不要只按肌肉痛持续观察。
advice.en: Pause strenuous activity and record breathing changes. Do not keep observing it solely as muscle pain.

shortDescription.zh: 深呼吸或咳嗽时胸部锐痛。
shortDescription.en: Sharp chest pain with deep breathing or coughing.

triggers.zh: 呼吸道感染、咳嗽或胸壁牵拉
triggers.en: Respiratory infection, coughing or chest-wall strain

threshold.zh: 呼吸困难、咳血、嘴唇发青、突发剧烈胸痛或晕厥时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for difficulty breathing, coughing blood, blue lips, sudden severe chest pain or fainting.

name.zh: 眼表刺激或结膜炎样表现（可能）

advice.zh: 停止佩戴隐形眼镜，避免揉眼。
advice.en: Stop contact lenses and avoid rubbing the eye.

shortDescription.zh: 眼红、异物感、流泪或灼痛。
shortDescription.en: Redness, grittiness, watering or burning in the eye.

triggers.zh: 干燥、异物、隐形眼镜或过敏
triggers.en: Dryness, a foreign body, contact lenses or allergy

threshold.zh: 视力下降、畏光明显、剧烈疼痛、角膜外伤或红眼伴恶心头痛时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for reduced vision, marked light sensitivity, severe pain, eye injury, or a red eye with nausea and headache.

name.zh: 外耳或中耳炎样表现（可能）

advice.zh: 保持耳道干燥，不要把棉签或药液伸入耳道。
advice.en: Keep the ear dry and do not insert cotton buds or unprescribed drops.

shortDescription.zh: 耳痛伴触痛、分泌物、发热或听力下降。
shortDescription.en: Ear pain with tenderness, discharge, fever or reduced hearing.

triggers.zh: 上呼吸道感染、进水或耳道刺激
triggers.en: An upper-airway infection, water exposure or ear-canal irritation

threshold.zh: 耳后肿痛、耳廓被推起、突发听力下降、眩晕或高热时尽快急诊评估。
threshold.en: Seek urgent assessment for swelling behind the ear, a pushed-out ear, sudden hearing loss, vertigo or high fever.

name.zh: 急性晶体性关节炎样发作（可能）

advice.zh: 抬高并短时间冷敷，避免挤压和饮酒。
advice.en: Elevate and use a short wrapped cold pack.

shortDescription.zh: 突然出现关节红肿、局部发热可见于晶体相关炎症，也可能有感染等原因，需要检查区分。
shortDescription.en: Sudden joint swelling/redness and local heat can occur with crystal-related inflammation or infection and need examination to distinguish the causes.

triggers.zh: 高嘌呤饮食、饮酒、脱水或关节负荷
triggers.en: Purine-rich food, alcohol, dehydration or joint stress

threshold.zh: 红热肿胀的关节应当天评估，未报告发热也不能排除感染；明显不适或快速加重立即就医。
threshold.en: A red, hot, swollen joint needs same-day assessment even when fever is unreported; seek immediate care if markedly unwell or rapidly worsening.

name.zh: 单侧下肢血栓警示模式（需急诊排查）

advice.zh: 不要按摩或剧烈运动来“揉开”，尽快接受医疗评估。
advice.en: Do not massage or exercise to try to clear it.

shortDescription.zh: 单侧腿部肿痛、发热或皮肤颜色变化。
shortDescription.en: One-sided leg swelling, pain, warmth or skin-colour change.

triggers.zh: 久坐、近期手术、妊娠或既往血栓风险
triggers.en: Prolonged immobility, recent surgery, pregnancy or prior clot risk

threshold.zh: 呼吸困难、胸痛、咳血、晕厥或心跳明显加快时立即呼叫急救。
threshold.en: Call emergency services for breathlessness, chest pain, coughing blood, fainting or a markedly fast heartbeat.

name.zh: 左下腹憩室病或憩室炎样表现（需鉴别）
name.en: Possible left-sided diverticular disease or diverticulitis

advice.zh: 记录排便和进食关系，补充水分。
advice.en: Record the relation to meals and bowel movements and keep hydrated.

shortDescription.zh: 左下腹痛伴排便改变，可伴发热。
shortDescription.en: Left-lower abdominal pain with bowel changes, sometimes with fever.

triggers.zh: 低纤维饮食、便秘或结肠局部炎症
triggers.en: Low fibre intake, constipation or local colonic inflammation

threshold.zh: 持续加重的腹痛、发热寒战、反复呕吐、腹胀不能排便排气或血便时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for worsening constant pain, fever or chills, repeated vomiting, a swollen bowel with no stool or gas, or blood in stool.

name.zh: 胆绞痛或胆囊疾病样表现（需鉴别）
name.en: Possible biliary colic or gallbladder disease

advice.zh: 避免继续进食高脂食物，记录疼痛持续时间和是否向背部放射，尽快就医评估。
advice.en: Avoid further high-fat meals, record duration and spread to the back, and arrange prompt medical assessment.

shortDescription.zh: 右上腹或上腹持续痛，可伴恶心、呕吐。
shortDescription.en: Sustained right-upper or central-upper abdominal pain with nausea or vomiting.

triggers.zh: 高脂餐后胆囊收缩或胆道阻塞
triggers.en: Gallbladder contraction after a fatty meal or biliary blockage

threshold.zh: 右上腹痛伴发热或寒战应当天评估，不必等高热；黄疸、持续加重或明显不适时急诊。
threshold.en: Right upper abdominal pain with fever or chills needs same-day assessment without waiting for a high fever. Jaundice, progressive pain or marked illness needs emergency care.

name.zh: 下尿路感染线索

advice.zh: 尽快做尿液评估，补充平时适量水分。
advice.en: Arrange urine assessment and keep ordinary hydration.

shortDescription.zh: 尿痛伴尿频或尿急；侧腰痛和发烧另按肾感染警示评估。
shortDescription.en: Painful urination with frequency/urgency; flank pain and fever raise a separate kidney-infection concern.

triggers.zh: 细菌上行感染、饮水不足或排尿受阻
triggers.en: Ascending bacterial infection, low fluid intake or impaired drainage

threshold.zh: 高热寒战、意识改变、持续呕吐、明显血尿、无法排尿或腰侧剧痛时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for high fever or chills, confusion, persistent vomiting, marked blood in urine, inability to urinate or severe flank pain.

name.zh: 胃食管反流线索

advice.zh: 少量分餐，避开诱发食物，饭后保持直立。
advice.en: Eat smaller meals, avoid trigger foods and stay upright after eating.

shortDescription.zh: 反酸伴烧灼感，进食或躺下后加重。
shortDescription.en: Sour regurgitation with burning, worse after meals or lying down.

triggers.zh: 餐后平卧、油腻辛辣食物、咖啡因或饮酒
triggers.en: Lying down after meals, fatty or spicy food, caffeine or alcohol

threshold.zh: 胸部压迫伴气短、冷汗、晕厥，或呕血、黑便、进行性吞咽困难时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Urgent care is needed for pressure-like chest pain with breathlessness, sweating or fainting, or for vomiting blood, black stool or progressive swallowing difficulty.

name.zh: 牙源性脓肿（需尽快牙科评估）
name.en: Possible dental abscess requiring dental assessment

advice.zh: 尽快预约急诊牙科。
advice.en: Arrange urgent dental care.

shortDescription.zh: 牙痛伴牙龈或面部肿胀、流脓或发热。
shortDescription.en: Toothache with gum or facial swelling, pus or fever.

triggers.zh: 龋病进展、牙裂或牙周感染
triggers.en: Advanced decay, a tooth crack or periodontal infection

threshold.zh: 呼吸、吞咽或说话困难，眼周肿痛/视力变化，口底明显肿胀或无法张口时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Emergency care is needed for difficulty breathing, swallowing or speaking, eye swelling or vision change, marked floor-of-mouth swelling or inability to open the mouth.

name.zh: 咽炎或扁桃体炎样表现（需鉴别）

advice.zh: 补充水分，选择温软食物，避免烟雾刺激。
advice.en: Keep hydrated, choose soft warm foods and avoid smoke.

shortDescription.zh: 咽痛、吞咽痛，可伴发热或咳嗽。
shortDescription.en: Sore throat or painful swallowing, sometimes with fever or cough.

triggers.zh: 病毒感染、密切接触或烟雾刺激
triggers.en: Viral infection, close contact or smoke irritation

threshold.zh: 呼吸困难、无法吞咽液体、流口水、声音含糊、单侧明显肿胀或高热寒战时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for breathing difficulty, inability to swallow fluids, drooling, a muffled voice, marked one-sided swelling or high fever with chills.

name.zh: 盆腔或会阴疼痛（需按泌尿/肠道/生殖症状鉴别）
name.en: Pelvic or perineal pain requiring urinary, bowel or reproductive assessment

advice.zh: 记录疼痛位置、周期、排尿排便和出血情况。
advice.en: Record the exact location, timing, urinary and bowel changes and any bleeding.

shortDescription.zh: 盆腔或会阴痛，可能伴排尿、排便、周期或出血变化。
shortDescription.en: Pelvic or perineal pain with possible urinary, bowel, menstrual or bleeding changes.

triggers.zh: 泌尿、肠道、生殖系统症状或盆底肌负荷
triggers.en: Urinary, bowel or reproductive symptoms, or pelvic-floor load

threshold.zh: 可能怀孕伴单侧剧痛/出血/晕厥，或高热、持续呕吐、无法排尿、剧烈加重时立即急诊。
threshold.en: Emergency assessment is needed for possible pregnancy with one-sided severe pain, bleeding or fainting, or for fever, persistent vomiting, inability to urinate or rapidly worsening pain.

name.zh: 外伤性骨损伤线索

advice.zh: 停止负重和剧烈活动，保护患处并尽快安排医学评估。
advice.en: Stop weight-bearing and strenuous activity, protect the area and arrange medical assessment.

shortDescription.zh: 外伤后局部骨点压痛、肿胀或不能承重；需检查区分挫伤与骨折。
shortDescription.en: Focal bony tenderness, swelling or inability to bear weight after injury needs assessment for fracture.

triggers.zh: 跌倒、碰撞、重复冲击或突然增加的负重
triggers.en: A fall, impact, repeated impact or sudden weight-bearing increase

threshold.zh: 开放伤口、明显畸形、肢体发冷发白/麻木、疼痛快速加重或无法承重时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek urgent care for an open wound, deformity, a cold pale or numb limb, rapidly worsening pain or inability to bear weight.

name.zh: 自主神经功能异常线索（需结合器官症状评估）
name.en: Possible autonomic dysfunction requiring organ-specific assessment

advice.zh: 记录症状发生时的体位、心率感受、进食、排尿排便和用药变化。
advice.en: Record posture, perceived heart rate, meals, bowel or bladder changes and medicines when symptoms occur.

shortDescription.zh: 心悸、体位性眩晕、出汗或胃肠和膀胱功能变化。
shortDescription.en: Palpitations, postural dizziness, sweating or bowel and bladder changes.

triggers.zh: 体位变化、脱水、感染、压力或基础疾病
triggers.en: Posture change, dehydration, infection, stress or an underlying condition

threshold.zh: 晕厥、胸痛、严重气短、意识改变、持续呕吐或无法排尿时立即就医。
threshold.en: Seek emergency care for fainting, chest pain, severe breathlessness, confusion, persistent vomiting or inability to urinate.

name.zh: 心肌缺血相关胸痛（需排查）

shortDescription.zh: 胸部压迫或烧灼不适，可向手臂、背部或下颌扩散。
shortDescription.en: Chest pressure or burning may spread to the arm, back or jaw.

triggers.zh: 冠状动脉供血不足；活动或应激可诱发，也可在静息时发生。
triggers.en: Reduced coronary blood supply; exertion or stress can trigger it, but it can occur at rest.

advice.zh: 立即停止活动；新发或持续胸部不适应尽快评估，勿自行驾车。
advice.en: Stop exertion. New or ongoing chest discomfort needs prompt assessment; do not drive yourself.

threshold.zh: 胸部不适持续不缓解，或伴气短、冷汗、晕厥：立即联系急救。
threshold.en: Ongoing chest discomfort, breathlessness, cold sweat or fainting: call emergency services.

name.zh: 胰腺炎样上腹痛（需排查）

shortDescription.zh: 上腹持续痛可向背部放射，常伴恶心或呕吐。
shortDescription.en: Persistent upper abdominal pain may spread to the back, with nausea or vomiting.

triggers.zh: 胆结石、饮酒等可相关；需血液检查及必要的影像检查明确。
triggers.en: Gallstones or alcohol may contribute; blood tests and sometimes imaging establish the cause.

advice.zh: 持续上腹痛应当日就医；避免饮酒，记录起病、进食关系及放射位置。
advice.en: Seek same-day assessment for persistent upper abdominal pain. Avoid alcohol and record onset and spread.

threshold.zh: 突发剧烈持续腹痛、反复呕吐、发热或气短：立即急诊。
threshold.en: Sudden severe persistent abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, fever or breathlessness: emergency assessment.

name.zh: 肝胆疾病相关不适（需鉴别）

shortDescription.zh: 右上腹不适伴黄疸等表现，需要评估肝功能和胆道。
shortDescription.en: Right-upper abdominal discomfort with jaundice needs liver and biliary assessment.

triggers.zh: 肝脏炎症或胆道阻塞等；不能仅从疼痛判断具体原因。
triggers.en: Liver inflammation or biliary obstruction, among other causes; pain alone cannot distinguish these.

advice.zh: 出现黄疸应尽快就医检查；暂停饮酒，核对近期药物及保健品。
advice.en: Seek urgent assessment for jaundice. Avoid alcohol and review recent medicines and supplements.

threshold.zh: 黄疸合并发热寒战、持续腹痛、反复呕吐或意识变化：立即急诊。
threshold.en: Jaundice with fever/chills, persistent pain, repeated vomiting or altered awareness: emergency assessment.

name.zh: 脾区疼痛与损伤（需排查）

shortDescription.zh: 左肋后或左上腹痛；受撞击后需考虑脾损伤。
shortDescription.en: Pain behind the left ribs or in the left upper abdomen; impact raises concern for splenic injury.

triggers.zh: 腹部或左下胸撞击；脾肿大也可产生局部不适。
triggers.en: Abdominal or lower-left chest trauma; an enlarged spleen may also cause discomfort.

advice.zh: 外伤后左上腹痛应尽快评估；停止运动，避免再撞击或反复按压。
advice.en: Promptly assess left-upper abdominal pain after trauma. Stop sport and avoid further impact or repeated pressing.

threshold.zh: 外伤后腹痛伴眩晕、苍白、心跳快或晕厥：立即联系急救。
threshold.en: Pain after trauma with dizziness, pallor, rapid heartbeat or fainting: call emergency services.

name.zh: 牙本质敏感

shortDescription.zh: 冷热引发的短暂牙痛，刺激停止后很快缓解。
shortDescription.en: Brief thermal tooth pain that settles when the trigger ends.

triggers.zh: 牙龈退缩、牙本质暴露或牙釉质磨损。
triggers.en: Exposed dentin, gum recession or enamel wear.

advice.zh: 轻柔刷牙，减少酸性饮食；反复出现预约牙科。
advice.en: Brush gently, reduce acidic foods and arrange dental review if recurrent.

threshold.zh: 转为持续痛、自发痛或肿胀时尽快牙科检查。
threshold.en: Lingering/spontaneous pain or swelling needs prompt dental assessment.

name.zh: 牙周支持组织异常线索

shortDescription.zh: 牙齿松动或牙龈退缩，伴出血、肿胀或异味。
shortDescription.en: Loose teeth or receding gums with bleeding, swelling or bad breath.

triggers.zh: 牙菌斑、吸烟等；需牙周探诊判断支持组织损伤。
triggers.en: Plaque and smoking; periodontal examination assesses tissue damage.

advice.zh: 预约牙周检查；轻柔清洁牙齿及牙缝，避免自行拔牙。
advice.en: Arrange periodontal assessment; clean teeth/interdental spaces gently.

threshold.zh: 明显松动、持续出血或肿痛加重尽快牙科就诊。
threshold.en: Marked looseness, persistent bleeding or worsening swelling needs prompt care.

name.zh: 过敏性鼻炎线索

shortDescription.zh: 清水鼻涕或喷嚏，伴鼻痒、鼻塞。
shortDescription.en: Watery discharge or sneezing with nasal itch or blockage.

triggers.zh: 花粉、尘螨、宠物等过敏原接触。
triggers.en: Exposure to pollen, dust mites or pets.

advice.zh: 减少已知过敏原接触；鼻腔冲洗使用无菌或煮沸冷却的水。
advice.en: Reduce known allergen exposure; use sterile or boiled/cooled water for rinses.

threshold.zh: 喘息、呼吸困难立即就医；持续影响睡眠预约评估。
threshold.en: Wheezing or breathing difficulty needs urgent care; persistent sleep disruption needs review.

name.zh: 髌股疼痛线索

shortDescription.zh: 前膝负荷痛，在上下楼或蹲起时加重。
shortDescription.en: Anterior knee load pain worsened by stairs or squatting.

triggers.zh: 近期跑跳增多、负荷变化或肌力不足。
triggers.en: Increased running/jumping, load changes or reduced strength.

advice.zh: 暂减诱发负荷，逐步恢复活动；反复疼痛可做康复评估。
advice.en: Reduce provoking loads temporarily; resume gradually and seek rehabilitation if recurrent.

threshold.zh: 不能承重、急性肿胀或关节卡住尽快就诊。
threshold.en: Inability to bear weight, acute swelling or locking needs prompt review.

name.zh: 肾感染警示组合

shortDescription.zh: 侧腰痛伴发烧或寒战，可同时尿痛、尿频或呕吐。
shortDescription.en: Flank pain with fever/chills, sometimes urinary symptoms or vomiting.

triggers.zh: 细菌感染由下尿路上行等；需尿液和临床检查。
triggers.en: Ascending urinary infection; requires urine testing and clinical assessment.

advice.zh: 当日就医；能饮水时少量补水，不要仅按普通腰痛处理。
advice.en: Seek same-day care; sip fluids if able and do not treat as ordinary back pain.

threshold.zh: 意识改变、虚弱晕厥、持续呕吐或可能怀孕应立即急诊。
threshold.en: Confusion, fainting, persistent vomiting or possible pregnancy needs urgent care.

name.zh: 餐后消化不良线索

shortDescription.zh: 餐后上腹饱胀、早饱，可能伴恶心。
shortDescription.en: Post-meal upper abdominal fullness or early satiety, sometimes nausea.

triggers.zh: 大餐、油腻饮食、酒精或压力；持续症状需要检查。
triggers.en: Large/fatty meals, alcohol or stress; persistent symptoms need assessment.

advice.zh: 小份规律进餐，记录食物与症状；避免餐后立即躺下。
advice.en: Eat smaller regular meals, record triggers and avoid lying down just after eating.

threshold.zh: 体重下降、吞咽困难、反复呕吐或消化道出血尽快就医。
threshold.en: Weight loss, swallowing difficulty, repeated vomiting or bleeding needs prompt care.

name.zh: 睡眠不足相关疲劳

shortDescription.zh: 睡眠不足或失眠后，白天困倦或乏力。
shortDescription.en: Daytime sleepiness or fatigue following insufficient sleep or insomnia.

triggers.zh: 作息紊乱、熬夜、压力或睡眠质量下降。
triggers.en: Irregular schedules, late nights, stress or poor-quality sleep.

advice.zh: 固定起床时间，保证睡眠机会；困倦时暂停驾驶和危险操作。
advice.en: Keep a consistent wake time, allow enough sleep and avoid driving when sleepy.

threshold.zh: 乏力持续数周、严重打鼾憋醒或改善睡眠后仍明显不适需评估。
threshold.en: Weeks of fatigue, choking/snoring or symptoms despite better sleep need assessment.

name.zh: 久坐与姿势相关不适

shortDescription.zh: 久坐后颈肩、腰背或髋部酸痛，休息或轻活动后缓解。
shortDescription.en: Neck, shoulder, back or hip aching after sitting, eased by rest or gentle movement.

triggers.zh: 长时间固定姿势、桌椅高度不合适或活动不足。
triggers.en: Prolonged static posture, workstation mismatch or low activity.

advice.zh: 定时起身变换姿势，轻缓活动；调整屏幕和座椅高度。
advice.en: Take regular movement breaks, change position and adjust screen/chair height.

threshold.zh: 外伤、发烧、进行性无力或会阴麻木应就医，不能归为久坐。
threshold.en: Injury, fever, progressive weakness or saddle numbness needs medical assessment.

name.zh: 运动后延迟性肌肉酸痛

shortDescription.zh: 新运动或负荷增加后1至3天出现肌肉酸痛、僵硬。
shortDescription.en: Muscle soreness/stiffness 1–3 days after unfamiliar or increased exercise.

triggers.zh: 不熟悉的运动或偏心负荷增加。
triggers.en: Unaccustomed activity or increased eccentric loading.

advice.zh: 暂降强度，轻活动并休息；逐步增加训练量。
advice.en: Reduce intensity, stay gently active and rest; increase training gradually.

threshold.zh: 尿呈茶色、明显肌无力、严重肿胀或疼痛持续加重立即就医。
threshold.en: Tea-coloured urine, marked weakness, severe swelling or worsening pain needs urgent care.

name.zh: 久站负荷相关不适

shortDescription.zh: 久站后腿脚酸胀或沉重，休息后减轻。
shortDescription.en: Leg/foot aching or heaviness after prolonged standing, eased by rest.

triggers.zh: 长时间站立、鞋不合适或近期负荷增加。
triggers.en: Prolonged standing, unsuitable footwear or increased load.

advice.zh: 交替坐站，休息时抬腿；穿合脚鞋并逐步增加活动耐受。
advice.en: Alternate sitting/standing, elevate legs at rest and use suitable footwear.

threshold.zh: 新发单侧肿胀、红热或气短及时就医。
threshold.en: New one-sided swelling, redness/heat or breathlessness needs urgent review.

name.zh: 缺水相关不适线索

shortDescription.zh: 口渴口干伴尿色深或尿量减少。
shortDescription.en: Thirst/dry mouth with dark urine or reduced urine output.

triggers.zh: 饮水不足、出汗、发烧、腹泻或呕吐。
triggers.en: Low intake, sweating, fever, diarrhoea or vomiting.

advice.zh: 能吞咽时少量多次补水；记录饮水和尿量，持续不适就诊。
advice.en: Sip fluids regularly if able to swallow; monitor intake/output and seek review if persistent.

threshold.zh: 意识变化、晕厥、持续少尿或无法饮水立即就医。
threshold.en: Confusion, fainting, persistent low urine or inability to drink needs urgent care.

name.zh: 屏幕使用相关眼干

shortDescription.zh: 长时间看屏幕后眼干或沙粒样异物感。
shortDescription.en: Dry or gritty eyes during prolonged screen use.

triggers.zh: 眨眼减少、空调环境或隐形眼镜。
triggers.en: Reduced blinking, air-conditioned rooms or contact lenses.

advice.zh: 定时离屏远眺、主动眨眼；不适时暂停隐形眼镜。
advice.en: Take screen breaks, blink regularly and pause contact lenses when uncomfortable.

threshold.zh: 眼痛伴视力下降、畏光或眼外伤尽快眼科就医。
threshold.en: Eye pain with reduced vision, light sensitivity or injury needs urgent eye care.

name.zh: 便秘相关腹部不适

shortDescription.zh: 排便减少伴干硬便或排便费力，可有腹胀。
shortDescription.en: Reduced bowel movements with hard stools or straining, sometimes bloating.

triggers.zh: 纤维或饮水不足、活动少、作息改变或药物影响。
triggers.en: Low fibre/fluid intake, inactivity, routine changes or medicines.

advice.zh: 逐步增加膳食纤维，适当饮水和活动，规律如厕。
advice.en: Increase dietary fibre gradually, drink appropriately, stay active and keep a toilet routine.

threshold.zh: 剧痛、反复呕吐、血便或无法排气尽快就医。
threshold.en: Severe pain, repeated vomiting, bloody stools or inability to pass wind needs prompt care.

name.zh: 肠易激样反复不适

shortDescription.zh: 反复数月腹痛，排便后缓解，并有便秘或腹泻变化。
shortDescription.en: Months of recurring abdominal pain relieved by bowel movements with altered stools.

triggers.zh: 食物、压力或肠道敏感性变化；需排除其他原因。
triggers.en: Food, stress or gut sensitivity; other causes need exclusion.

advice.zh: 记录饮食和排便规律，预约检查；避免一次性过度限制饮食。
advice.en: Keep a food/stool diary and arrange assessment; avoid excessive dietary restriction.

threshold.zh: 血便、发烧、体重下降或新发持续疼痛需及时检查。
threshold.en: Bleeding, fever, weight loss or new persistent pain needs prompt investigation.

name.zh: 肋软骨及胸壁疼痛线索

shortDescription.zh: 胸骨旁按压痛，深呼吸或转动上身可加重。
shortDescription.en: Tenderness near the sternum, worse with breathing or upper-body movement.

triggers.zh: 胸壁负荷、反复咳嗽等；压痛不能排除心肺原因。
triggers.en: Chest-wall load or repeated coughing; tenderness cannot exclude heart/lung causes.

advice.zh: 减少诱发动作，保持轻活动；新发不明胸痛应做临床评估。
advice.en: Reduce provoking movements, stay gently active and have unexplained new chest pain assessed.

threshold.zh: 压迫性胸痛伴气短、冷汗、晕厥立即急救。
threshold.en: Pressure-like chest pain with breathlessness, cold sweat or fainting is an emergency.

name.zh: 贫血或血液异常检查线索

shortDescription.zh: 无故淤青或异常出血，伴乏力、苍白或反复感染。
shortDescription.en: Unexplained bruising/bleeding with fatigue, pallor or recurrent infections.

triggers.zh: 可能涉及血细胞异常等多种原因，胸骨压痛本身不提示白血病。
triggers.en: Several causes can affect blood cells; sternal tenderness alone does not suggest leukaemia.

advice.zh: 尽快安排血常规和临床评估，记录出血部位和持续时间。
advice.en: Arrange a blood count/clinical assessment promptly; record bleeding sites and duration.

threshold.zh: 出血不止、晕厥、明显气短或高热立即就医。
threshold.en: Uncontrolled bleeding, fainting, marked breathlessness or high fever needs immediate care.

name.zh: 骨应力性损伤线索

shortDescription.zh: 增加负荷后局部骨点压痛，负重时加重。
shortDescription.en: Focal bony tenderness after increased load, worse with weight-bearing.

triggers.zh: 跑跳量快速增加、反复负荷或骨强度下降。
triggers.en: Rapid increases in running/jumping, repetitive load or reduced bone strength.

advice.zh: 暂停跑跳冲击负荷，安排检查；不能仅靠症状判断骨折。
advice.en: Stop impact loading and arrange assessment; symptoms alone cannot establish a fracture.

threshold.zh: 不能承重、进行性疼痛或明显肿胀尽快就医。
threshold.en: Inability to bear weight, progressive pain or marked swelling needs prompt review.

name.zh: 关节感染警示组合

shortDescription.zh: 关节肿痛伴发烧或寒战，活动或承重困难。
shortDescription.en: A swollen joint with fever/chills and difficulty moving or bearing weight.

triggers.zh: 关节感染等急性原因；不能按普通劳损观察。
triggers.en: Possible joint infection or another acute cause; do not assume ordinary strain.

advice.zh: 当日急诊评估，避免继续负重或按摩患处。
advice.en: Seek same-day urgent assessment; avoid continued loading or massage.

threshold.zh: 意识改变、虚弱晕厥或全身迅速恶化立即急救。
threshold.en: Confusion, fainting or rapidly worsening illness is an emergency.

triggers.zh: 嚼东西时加重
triggers.en: Worse with chewing

triggers.zh: 撞伤或摔倒后
triggers.en: After injury

triggers.zh: 扭到之后
triggers.en: After twisting injury

triggers.zh: 运动或负荷增加后
triggers.en: After exercise/load increase

triggers.zh: 反复用力 / 重复动作
triggers.en: Repetitive loading

triggers.zh: 动起来更不舒服
triggers.en: Provoked by movement

triggers.zh: 坐久了之后
triggers.en: After prolonged sitting

triggers.zh: 站久了之后
triggers.en: After prolonged standing

triggers.zh: 休息后减轻
triggers.en: Better with rest

triggers.zh: 轻活动后减轻
triggers.en: Better with gentle movement

triggers.zh: 没睡够 / 熬夜
triggers.en: Insufficient sleep

triggers.zh: 睡不着 / 睡不好
triggers.en: Insomnia

triggers.zh: 最近压力大
triggers.en: Stress

triggers.zh: 最近喝水少
triggers.en: Low fluid intake

triggers.zh: 长时间看电脑或手机
triggers.en: Prolonged screen use

triggers.zh: 吃完后更明显
triggers.en: Worse after meals

triggers.zh: 油腻餐后疼
triggers.en: Pain after fatty meals

triggers.zh: 排便后减轻
triggers.en: Better after a bowel movement

triggers.zh: 轻碰 / 刷牙就诱发
triggers.en: Triggered by light touch

triggers.zh: 转身或牵拉时痛
triggers.en: Pain on twisting/stretching

triggers.zh: 转头时加重
triggers.en: Worse with turning head

triggers.zh: 举起手臂时加重
triggers.en: Worse with raising arm

triggers.zh: 侧躺压肩时疼
triggers.en: Shoulder pain lying on side

triggers.zh: 上下楼更疼
triggers.en: Worse on stairs

triggers.zh: 蹲下站起更疼
triggers.en: Worse with squatting

triggers.zh: 跪地时加重
triggers.en: Worse with kneeling

triggers.zh: 弯着胳膊更麻
triggers.en: Worse with elbow bent

triggers.zh: 甩甩手后好点
triggers.en: Better after shaking hand

triggers.zh: 躺下后加重
triggers.en: Worse lying down

triggers.zh: 走路负重时加重
triggers.en: Worse with weight-bearing

triggers.zh: 磨牙 / 经常咬紧牙
triggers.en: Grinding / clenching

triggers.zh: 起身或变换姿势诱发
triggers.en: Triggered by position change

triggers.zh: 活动时胸闷
triggers.en: Exertional chest pressure
